verdict.rationale: Puzzle's core product markets one-click real-time financial reports, cash & accrual books, and instant startup metrics (ARR, burn, runway), which directly map to on-demand P&L/balance sheet/cash-flow generation for any period; community sentiment corroborates it as a functional QuickBooks alternative for real-time books. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming balance sheet/cash-flow statement outputs specifically, and independent hands-on verification of report accuracy across periods.
